svg.title: Figure 3-1 · ODD taxonomy
svg.desc: Tree of the reference ODD of WP-C-02 §3.1: Road type, Geometry, Lane markings, Speed, Weather, Lighting, Road surface, Traffic, VRUs, Geography, Infrastructure, Connectivity, Vehicle state, Driver state. Each attribute shows the value included in ODD-H and in ODD-A. The horizontal curve radius bound is proposed (GAP-04, OI-2), grade and banking bounds are to be confirmed (OI-5), the ambient temperature bound is TBD (OI-3), and the ODD-A inclusion is to be confirmed (OI-4).
svg.text: Reference ODD of §3.1 by category and attribute, with the value included in ODD-H and ODD-A. The whole ODD is proposed.
